## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Barcelona, Spain. It starts at 16 Carrer de la Portaferrissa.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Strum your way into the Rock Museum Barcelona - Guitar Legends Hall, a 1200 m2 odyssey through rock history. The journey kicks off in an old blues bar setting, symbolic of rock's roots, then escalates to stadium shows, a nostalgic 1960s TV studio, and a lively festival meadow designed to immerse visitors in the world of rock.
>
> Become a part of the melody as vintage jukeboxes spring to life at your touch, interactive record stores allow you to sample iconic tracks, and screens connect you with immersive music videos. Stand before the legendary guitars that shaped the sound of generations and take the chance to showcase your own rock talent by strumming on real guitars.
>
> Watch as the legendary icons materialize before you appearing as life-like holograms to perform the rock concert of your wildest dreams!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €15.75. It was rated 4.9 out of 5 from 13 ratings and 9 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
